title: Route Hancom features by control surface and exact evidence
when: An agent needs any Hancom application or HWPX feature controlled by code.
do: Use capability lookup by functional family, then api lookup by exact Action/ParameterSet/member.
Keep desktop IHwpObject, web HwpCtrl, HWPX file model and commercial SDK as separate surfaces.
Inspect action range/dummy hints, required explicit parameter sets and source page/version.
For a missing manual member, use source-backed read-only installed typelib discovery before concluding unsupported.
check: Documentation, installed exposure, callability and native behavior are separate states.
All captured actions are routed or explicitly retained in other-documented-actions.
limitation: Official documented coverage is broad; no claim that every UI feature is automatable or execution-qualified. Parameter field extraction is best effort with exact full-page fallback.
